Name: TranscriTranslator
Author: Felipe Drummond
Description: Voice dictation: records the microphone, transcribes it at OpenAI and pastes the text into the focused field. Every key is configurable — clean-up, translation, rewriting, your own dictionary and appearance.

Actions.Name: Dictate
Actions.Tooltip: Records the microphone, transcribes it and pastes into the focused field. Pick a preset in the property inspector.
